document_metadata.title: 25、INT. EXAMINATION AREA
document_metadata.summary: Austin Powers, unfrozen in 1997, teams up with Vanessa Kensington, daughter of his former partner, to stop Dr. Evil, while adjusting to the 1990s and dealing with social awkwardness.

entities.name: Technicians transport Austin to a screened cleansing area
entities.description: Technicians lead a drowsy Austin to a partitioned section where only his head and feet are visible, preparing him for the cleansing procedure.

entities.name: Hot-water jets cleanse Austin's body
entities.description: A series of high-pressure hot-water jets wash Austin off as part of a decontamination or preparation process.

entities.name: Female announcer declares cleansing complete and initiates evacuation stage
entities.description: Over a public address system, a female announcer announces that the cleansing phase is finished and that Stage Five, evacuation, is beginning.

entities.name: Austin receives futuristic inoculations
entities.description: After cleansing, Austin is administered advanced medical injections as part of a cryogenic or reanimation protocol.

entities.name: Austin undergoes prolonged and irregular urination
entities.description: Austin urinates in a screened toilet area with an unusually long, intermittent stream, including multiple restarts and staccato bursts, monitored as part of a physiological process.

entities.name: Female announcer confirms completion of evacuation process
entities.description: After multiple phases of urination and pauses, the female announcer officially declares the evacuation process complete.

entities.name: Austin is placed in a cryogenic bed at extreme incline
entities.description: Austin lies in a bed positioned at a steep upward angle, resembling equipment from a scientific or horror laboratory setting, as part of cryogenic preservation.

entities.name: Nurse technicians administer injections and monitor Austin's vitals
entities.description: Medical personnel attach electrodes, IVs, and sensors to Austin and give injections while monitoring his biological functions during the cryogenic process.

entities.name: Austin regains consciousness and asks about his location
entities.description: Upon waking, Austin weakly inquires where he is, showing initial disorientation from the unfreezing process.

entities.name: Basil Exposition informs Austin of his cryogenic freezing and current year
entities.description: Basil Exposition tells Austin that he is in the Ministry of Defense in 1997 and has been cryogenically frozen for thirty years.

entities.name: Austin shouts uncontrollably due to unfreezing side effects
entities.description: Austin shouts loudly, expressing confusion and lack of vocal control, which Basil identifies as a temporary effect of the thawing process.

entities.name: Basil Exposition explains additional side effects of unfreezing
entities.description: Basil warns Austin that he may experience fever, dry mouth, and flatulence during moments of relaxation as residual effects of the cryogenic revival.

entities.name: Basil introduces Commander Gilmour and General Borschevsky to Austin
entities.description: Basil presents two officials—Commander Gilmour from Strategic Command and General Borschevsky from Russian Intelligence—to Austin after his revival.

entities.name: Austin Powers' Cryogenic Revival Procedure
entities.description: A structured, multi-stage medical and decontamination process designed to safely unfreeze and reactivate Austin Powers after thirty years of cryogenic suspension.

entities.name: Austin expresses shock at mention of Russian Intelligence
entities.description: Austin reacts with disbelief and accuses others of madness upon hearing that Russian Intelligence is involved, reflecting his outdated Cold War mindset.

entities.name: Basil Exposition informs Austin of post-Cold War world changes
entities.description: Basil tells Austin that much has changed since 1967, including the end of the Cold War and the West's victory, updating him on current geopolitical reality.

entities.name: Austin praises capitalism after misunderstanding world changes
entities.description: After believing the Soviet Union won the Cold War, Austin enthusiastically celebrates, only to immediately switch and praise capitalism when corrected.

entities.name: Commander Gilmour briefs Austin on Dr. Evil's threat
entities.description: Commander Gilmour informs Austin that the President is concerned about Dr. Evil, a dangerous criminal currently at large in Nevada.

entities.name: Basil Exposition assigns Austin to work with Ms. Kensington
entities.description: Basil informs Austin that he will immediately begin his mission working alongside Ms. Kensington, the daughter of a former colleague.

entities.name: Vanessa Kensington enters and introduces herself to Austin
entities.description: Vanessa Kensington, a top agent and daughter of Mrs. Kensington, enters the room, presents a stack of files, and begins her role in acclimating Austin to the 1990s.

entities.name: Austin mentally comments on Vanessa's appearance and loses inner monologue
entities.description: Austin internally admires Vanessa's looks and sexual appeal but accidentally speaks his thoughts aloud due to a side effect of the unfreezing process.

entities.name: Vanessa Kensington explains her role in Austin's reintegration
entities.description: Vanessa tells Austin that her job is to help him adjust to the cultural and social changes of the 1990s, indicating the beginning of his orientation process.

entities.name: Austin reveals his outdated views on sex and drugs
entities.description: Austin states that he will adapt well to the present as long as promiscuous sex and recreational drug use remain common, exposing his 1960s values.

entities.name: Vanessa shares that her mother spoke about Austin
entities.description: Vanessa informs Austin that her mother, the former agent Mrs. Kensington, has told her stories about him, establishing a personal connection.

entities.name: Austin makes a self-deprecating joke about his past behavior
entities.description: Austin responds to Vanessa's comment with a quip, saying he hopes the stories are lies so he won't be embarrassed, showing his characteristic humor.

entities.name: Basil Exposition privately warns Austin about Vanessa's dedication
entities.description: Basil pulls Austin aside to comment that Vanessa is highly dedicated, perhaps overly so, hinting at potential interpersonal tension.

entities.name: Basil Exposition gives final encouragement and caution to Austin
entities.description: Before leaving, Basil tells Austin 'good luck' and reminds him that the world is counting on him, then adds a final warning to be careful.
An explicit year mentioned as the last point of reference for Austin before his cryogenic freezing.

relations.subject: Virtucon Home Video
relations.description: The scene states that 'Virtucon Home Video presents "The Powers Collection"', which indicates a temporary promotional relationship where the company is actively offering or releasing the product. While 'presents' is not a direct synonym for ownership, in the context of media distribution, presenting a collection implies temporary custody and control over its release. Among the allowed relations, 'possesses' is the only one that plausibly fits, as it covers organizational custody of an object. The relationship is not permanent and is tied to the release phase, so persistence is 'phase'.
